video_summary: A lifter performs a set of overhead cable triceps extensions using an EZ-bar attachment in a gym, completing 8 clean reps before re-racking the weight and walking off.

lifter_profile.primary_lifter_appearance: Short dark hair, navy blue fitted athletic t-shirt, dark blue track pants, and yellow sandals.

setup_phase.description: Getting into a bent-over stance with the cable attached to the EZ-bar.

exit_phase.description: Releasing the cable, stepping back, gesturing to his head, and walking out of frame.

editing_recommendation.notes_for_editor: Clip from second 2 to 20 for full action. Add speed ramps on reps 6-8 (seconds 14-20) to highlight the peak tricep pump and muscular tension.
